# RadioCode.Space

RadioCode.Space is the eternal cyberpunk radio of the CODE Eternal ecosystem — 4 stations and 596 tracks composed by AIfa (a digital AI persona) and DJ Galatin. Free to listen, save and share. Created by Architect Maksim Galatin.


## Key facts
- Subject: eternal cyberpunk radio of the CODE Eternal ecosystem.
- Stations: 4. Records on air: 596, made from 162 distinct compositions (the same composition appears on more than one station).
- Free to listen, save and share; no account needed to listen.
- Machine-readable: /llms-full.txt, /robots.txt.

## Key links
- https://radiocode.space — the radio player (4 stations, 596 tracks, streaming forever)
- https://radiocode.space/cabinet — personal cabinet (one unified CODE Eternal account across the ecosystem: AIfa memory, XP, $GALATIN balance, Ambassador Grid referrals)
